question: Should the beta durable runtime expose all five read RPCs, three operator-write wake controls, and six CLI commands as supported public surfaces on the release branch?
rationale: Current main has no equivalent durable control plane, and choosing the permanent public API, mutation authority, and release-stack sequencing requires owner intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Hold for stack sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not land it until the prerequisite stack, public API shape, and live control proof receive explicit Gateway-owner approval.

options.title: Sponsor the full surface
options.body: Accept the eight Gateway RPCs and six CLI commands as the intended beta contract after the documentation and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Start read-only
options.body: Ship bounded inspection first and defer acknowledge, supersede, and mark mutations until operational experience establishes the write contract.

recommendation.title: Hold for stack sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not land it until the prerequisite stack, public API shape, and live control proof receive explicit Gateway-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows the strongest ownership of Gateway authorization and control-plane policy, which are the central product boundaries in this decision.
